title: Higher direct images commute with extension of an algebraically closed base field
statement: Let k be algebraically closed, K a field extension of k, f:X -> Spec k qcqs, n a natural number nonzero in k, and F an abelian etale sheaf on X with n times its identity zero. For each natural q there is an isomorphism g^*(R^q f_* F) ≅ R^q f\prime_* p^* F for the cartesian field-extension square (p,f\prime,f,g). These are the actual inverse-image and classical right-derived functors [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image, def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves].

source.place: Lemma 59.90.1, specialization to an algebraically closed base and a single sheaf

proof.text: Apply derived field-extension exchange to F in degree zero.

Exact inverse image commutes with degree-q homology. Identify the homology of each total derived direct image of a single complex with the classical rightDerived q. Compose these four natural isomorphisms to give the displayed isomorphism. For q=0 the same comparisons apply; zero coefficients and empty X give zero objects.

lean.statement:
theorem nonempty_fieldExtension_higherDirectImage_iso
    {k K : Type u} [Field k] [Field K] [IsAlgClosed k] [Algebra k K]
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    (n : ℕ) (hn : (n : k) ≠ 0)
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (hF : n • 𝟙 F = 0)
    (q : ℕ) :
    Nonempty
      ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K)))).obj
          (((lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f).rightDerived q).obj F) ≅
        ((lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
            (pullback.snd f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))))).rightDerived q).obj
          ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
            (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))))).obj F))
